name: Dragon dance head
summary: Boxy red and gold festival dance head with open mouth, big eyes, horn and draped scale cloth; for parades.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the cloth hem sits on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the head is about 600 px wide and 560 px tall; use about 0.5 for a head beside a person

params.name: color2
params.note: gold trim, horn, brows and scales

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = the head nods up and down

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror (head faces left, cloth trails right)
